payload.title: File:Deer Close-Up.jpg
payload.artist_html: Marisca Kadharmestan
payload.description_html:
Although this is just a regular deer, it's got something that makes it special. It's its smile. This picture would not have been as good without it, and probably would not be chosen to be in this very competition.
The same concept goes with humans. One is prone to more hopes and opportunities as they spread positivity to others.
